overall_summary: Recent 7-day performance data clearly shows that extreme space and planetary 'what-if' scenario content vastly outperforms psychological tricks, general animal facts, and standard historical queries on FACTVERSE. Videos utilizing hypothetical destruction, extreme cosmic environments, and high-value metric comparisons (e.g., diamond planets, extreme darkness, freezing stars, and orbital replacements) achieve the highest views-per-day and engagement metrics (likes-per-view). Conversely, standard biological or psychological trivia from early September are stalling completely.

winning_patterns.pattern: Hypothetical Planetary Immersion ('What If You Fell Into...')
winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (IYuce8vaU3Y) and 'What If You Fell Into the Planet of Burning Ice?' (8KEl0_pJ_68) garnered over 1,000 and 972 views rapidly within the recent observation window compared to flat older static facts.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on immersive, high-stakes hypothetical scenarios involving bizarre or extreme planetary environments.

winning_patterns.pattern: Extreme Cosmic Anomalies & Rare Material Weather
winning_patterns.evidence: Titles featuring bizarre physical extremes like 'The Planet Darker Than Coal' (v1rrcZLdp4U) and 'This Planet Rains Supersonic Rubies!' (QXuqYERlqSo) drove high view counts and strong like ratios relative to age.
winning_patterns.action: Produce more short-form concepts focusing on physics-defying celestial weather, extreme material extremes, and cosmic anomalies.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' (2fqaGqfsR4A, 5 views) and 'The Real Reason Songs Get Stuck In Your Head' (Jc04LVKNd2s, 17 views) suffer from severe decay and low engagement.
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize standalone psychological facts and standard memory trivia unless framed within a high-stakes survival or sci-fi context.

weak_patterns.pattern: Basic Animal Fact Lists without Extreme Stakes
weak_patterns.evidence: Simple declarative statements like 'Octopuses Have THREE Hearts' or basic animal longevity facts show flattening growth compared to planetary destruction hooks.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid standard textbook animal trivia; if covering fauna, pivot entirely toward cinematic animal survival or prehistoric apex predators.
